test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Machinist) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about slip gauges is true?

options.text: Slip gauges do not require calibration.
Slip gauges are used only for rough measurements.
Slip gauges are used for setting measuring instruments.
Slip gauges are flexible and can bend easily.

solution:
The correct answer is __Slip gauges are used for setting measuring instruments**(Option 3)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Slip gauges__ are precision tools used for accurate measurement settings.
 
• They are mainly used for calibrating measuring instruments and checking the accuracy of machine tools.
 
• Slip gauges are made of high-grade steel to ensure durability and accuracy.
 
• They are not flexible and do not bend easily, ensuring precise measurements.
 
• Slip gauges require regular calibration to maintain their accuracy.
 
• They are used for fine measurements, not rough measurements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Types of Slip Gauges:**

 
 
• Plain slip gauges: Used for general measurement and calibration purposes.
 
• Angular slip gauges: Used for precise angular measurements.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Slip Gauges:**
 
 
• Used in tool rooms, inspection departments, and laboratories for calibration.
 
• Commonly used in machining and manufacturing processes.
